Rael effectively targeted all their contacts and dossiers. He'd obviously planned for this.''"
"''And what about the radio?''"
"''Well, the transmitter looks intact.|Lepori and Avril Heert|{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}}} '''Lepori''' was a [[human]] who worked as a [[Technician|technical specialist]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] called her in as an [[inspector]] to [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], where she investigated the partially destroyed [[fractal radio]] of captured [[Axis network]] leader [[Luthen Rael]]. She was impressed by the rebel technology and reported her findings to bureau [[Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]], providing him with a location for Rael's assistant, [[Kleya Marki]], when she connected to the radio to send out a call for aid. Lepori later messaged Marki's radio so that Heert could trace her exact location. ==Biography== ===Exciting tech=== {{Quote|The easiest thing would be to take it offline and get it back to the lab.''"
"''I don't have time for that. I need a location.''"
"''All the options for that require a connection. I can't trace back something I don't have a—|Lepori and Avril Heert, before a beeping radio light cuts them off|}} Lepori was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[Technician|technical specialist]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]]. She was sometimes brought in by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] as an [[inspector]]{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{AD|Disney+}} and in [[1 BBY]] was summoned to [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' in such a capacity. The gallery's owner, [[Luthen Rael]], had been discovered to be head of the rebel [[Axis network]] and had been taking into custody at the gallery after mortally wounding himself. However, before his arrest, Rael had destroyed a [[fractal radio]] in the back of the gallery by pouring a metallic caustic substance over its switchboard. Lepori was assigned to analyze what she could of what was left of the device, which was still smoking when she found it. Rael was soon [[Death|killed]] by his assistant, [[Kleya Marki]], to prevent him being interrogated while Lepori continued investigating the gallery. She discovered that while the radio's storage files and signal library had been mostly destroyed, the device's [[transmitter]] was still intact and that the rebels had spliced their [[antenna]] into a metro tower next door and used Imperial broadcast power to transmit their messages. She relayed all this information to Imperial Security Bureau [[Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]] when he arrived in the gallery the next [[Local day|morning]], chuckling at the information about the antenna until Heert's assistant, [[ISB Attendant|Attendant]] [[Joydali]], shook his{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{AD|Disney+}} head at her to warn her to stop. ===Signal ploy=== Lepori explained to Heert that the most straightforward solution to analyzing the radio would be to take it offline and bring it to a laboratory, but Heert rejected the idea as he needed a location for Marki as quickly as possible. Lepori explained that for her to trace a location there would have to be a connection to the radio to trace back and that without one she could do nothing; however, she was cut off mid-sentence by a beeping from the radio and a flashing light, triggered by a connection from Marki sending out a request for aid from her rebel allies. Lepori was then able to provide Heert with Marki's location in an [[Axis network safehouse]] and the supervisor left to apprehend her. When Heert then arrived at [[Tomkip Towers]], where the safehouse was located, he had the [[ISB Central Office]] inform Lepori that he was ready. She then began sending a signal to Marki's radio from the gallery, creating a signal that Heert could trace to the rebel's exact location using a [[portable scanner]]. The ploy worked, and Heert accompanied an [[ISB Tactical]] [[squad]] to the safehouse, but was killed there by Marki's allies, allowing the rebel to escape Coruscant.{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|They had the antennae. Its ingenious. They spliced it into a metro tower next door. They've been using Imperial broadcast power for who knows how long.|Lepori|}} Lepori was quite impressed with the technology of the fractal radio and enjoyed solving the puzzle it presented her. She had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Lepori wore a light gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a two blue pips on her [[rank insignia plaque]] under a gray [[Clothing|trench coat]], black [[leather]] [[glove]]s, a black [[belt]], and a black [[Imperial kepi]]. Both the belt and [[hat]] were adorned with an [[officer's disk]] and Lepori also had two [[code cylinder]]s and an earpiece. ==Behind the scenes== Faiza was portrayed by [[Caoilfhionn Dunne]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], first appearing in the tenth and eleventh episodes, "[[Make It Stop]]" and "[[Who Else Knows?]]," both of which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The character's name had been previously revealed in late [[2024]] on Dunne's listing on the website of their talent agency.{{WebCite|url=https://www.unitedagents.co.uk/caoilfhionn-dunne|text=Caoilfhionn Dunne|work=[[Wikipedia:United Agents|United Agents]]|archivedate=20241113183008}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st|"[[Who Else Knows?]]"}} *{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-costume-design|text=The Costumes of ''Andor'' Season 2}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|lepori|Lepori}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ლეპორი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Security Bureau personnel]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Technicians of the Galactic Empire]]
